Dr. Ana Lopez

Postdoctoral Researcher

Return to archive↗

This is an inherited source-site record. Membership, biography, affiliations, and publication details have not been confirmed as BIOracle information.

Biography as supplied.

Dr. Lopez investigates spillover risks and ecological interactions of engineered organisms. Her research uses network theory and ecological modeling to assess potential impacts of synthetic biology on natural ecosystems and identify critical intervention points.

Areas of expertise

Spillover Risk · Network Analysis · Ecological Modeling

Education as supplied

  • PhD in Ecology and Evolution · UC Berkeley · 2020
  • MSc in Environmental Science · ETH Zurich · 2016
  • BSc in Biology · Humboldt University Berlin · 2014

Research interests

  • Ecological spillover modeling
  • Host-pathogen interactions
  • Biosafety risk assessment
  • Community ecology of engineered systems

Publication records as supplied

  • Network-based assessment of engineered organism spillover potential · Ecology Letters · 2023
  • Ecological risk factors in synthetic biology release · Trends in Ecology · 2022
